editorial:
Imagine finding a chest of toys that actually come from the future. That is exactly what happens to a group of middle school outcasts who feel like they do not fit in anywhere. You get to follow these kids as they discover gadgets that do things you would only see in a dream. The vibe is very much like those classic 80s kids' adventures where a bunch of friends team up to do something impossible. It is a lighthearted ride that focuses on friendship and the idea that being a loser in school does not mean you are not a hero in real life.

You will probably love the gadgets and the way the kids use their brains to outsmart the bad guy. The acting is natural, though the plot is pretty simple. While the special effects are not mind-blowing, they work well for a family movie. If you are looking for something easy to watch with your kids, you should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great way to keep this fun story forever.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, the kids use their future toys to stop the corporate madman from taking over. They realize that their friendship is their biggest strength, not just the gadgets. They manage to trick the villain and save their neighborhood from his evil plan. After the chaos ends, the kids are no longer seen as losers at school. They keep the lessons they learned about bravery and confidence, while the bad guy is finally defeated.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves nostalgic kids adventures and futuristic gadgets.
